premises.text: 3DLT is a marketplace for selling professional 3D-printable designs like iStock for 3D printing
premises.evidence_span: Think of us as the iStock photo of 3D printing

premises.text: Anyone from grandmother to grandson can find designs spanning frames to furniture to shoes
premises.evidence_span: everyone, from your grandmother to your grandson, can find and buy designs on 3DLT

premises.text: Buyers without printers use customization plus a 1,000-shop network for local pickup or shipping
premises.evidence_span: consumers that don't have their own 3D printers? With 3DLT, it's built right in

premises.text: Business model takes design revenue and print profit while printers compete down price
premises.evidence_span: Our system allows 3D printers to compete for your business. With competition comes commoditization, and that means lower pricing for you

premises.text: Designers open stores in minutes and earn passive income; buyers can also commission designers
premises.evidence_span: You can work directly with our designers to fast-track the innovation to new products

value.text: Change how people buy by letting them choose manufacture timing, place, and method

secondary_value.text: Cheaper, greener, better-quality printable products than mass manufacture
secondary_value.evidence_span: products that are cheaper, greener, and better quality than anything that is currently mass manufactured

causal_links.evidence_span: choose when, where, and how the products you buy are manufactured

notes: Market-flip-by-2020 and 'everyone will want what we sell' treated as vision (§4.1(4)); secondary_value captures greener/cheaper claim. Promo credits excluded. Two-domain structure this run.
